title: The benefits of doing nothing
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why do many people feel guilty when they are doing nothing?
Can boredom be useful for creativity or self-reflection?
What is the difference between healthy rest and simply wasting time?
Should workplaces include more genuinely quiet time with no meetings or messages?
How would your week change if you deliberately scheduled two hours to do absolutely nothing?
